purpose: Establish a reproducible native-rate codec encode/decode comparison pipeline on consumed development references. This technical study cannot establish perceptual impairment, transparency or generalization.

population.member_selection: All exact previously retained canonical deliveries; current private inventory is not reopened during preparation.

input_policy.adapter: Parse the exact canonical signed 24/32-bit PCM payload. Convert integer samples to exactly scaled float64, then pack IEEE binary32 little endian using round-to-nearest/ties-to-even. Write one metadata-free type-3 float WAV with a fact frame count. No resampling, dither, gain adjustment, clipping, fade, padding or excerpt selection.
controls: identity: retained exact float64 representation versus itself
float32_adapter: retained float64 representation versus binary32 roundtrip
input_policy.codec_reference: Exact binary32 input view, lifted to float64 without further rounding; report its private hash separately from the retained-source hash.
input_policy.precision_boundary: Binary32 conversion may change some signed 32-bit input values, including rounding a value immediately below positive full scale to 1.0. Do not clamp or hide it. This is an explicit adapter effect, not evidence of codec impairment.
input_policy.source_protection: Only read one existing delivery replay. Never rewrite source files, duplicate the retained corpus, read provider processed conditions/scores, or open the original acquired corpus.

condition_policy.selection: Two operating points in each already-qualified codec lineage; all new native-48-kHz recipe IDs. MP3 96/128 kbps CBR; native AAC-LC 96/128 kbps target bitrate; libopus 64/128 kbps hard CBR with 20 ms frames; libVorbis quality 2/6.
condition_policy.decoder_policy: Explicit FFmpeg mp3float, aac, opus and vorbis decoders; output interleaved little-endian float64 at the stream's native rate and channel layout, with no forced resampling/downmix or integer-output clipping.
condition_policy.heldout_policy: These are development lineages only. The FFmpeg libopus wrapper is not the distinct FFmpeg native Opus encoder-transfer candidate. No wrapper or file count creates an independent group.
condition_policy.defaults: Freeze exact binary/dependency closure and supplied arguments. Unspecified codec internals, including low-pass and psychoacoustic defaults, belong to that exact intervention. Their outputs are not quality labels.
condition_policy.determinism: Request FFmpeg bitexact container/codec modes, explicit Ogg serial offsets and oggenc serial 1. Verify encoded bytes, decoded bytes, packet metadata and comparison records across both replays; flags alone do not establish determinism.
condition_policy.syntax_verification: Installed help/version and primary documentation inspected; no actual encoder or decoder condition was run in preparation. Mocked tests do not prove successful real codec invocation.
condition_policy.family_exposure: All four families are used for technical development. None is reserved here as an unseen-codec validation set; later transfer claims must explicitly account for prior exposure, rather than treating different files as an unseen family.

alignment_policy.execution: Run the unchanged channel-preserving alignment implementation once at the four-active-second mode. For study eligibility, cap its raw block-based active duration by aligned_frames / 48000, preserving both values and the cap-applied flag. Subtle eligibility requires a supported raw record and at least four bounded seconds; quality-duration eligibility requires eight. This is not a metric/oracle execution.
alignment_policy.delay_padding: Record demuxer packet timestamps, skip-sample and discard-padding fields, stream timebase and decoded frame count. Let the bound decoder apply its own declared container delay/padding semantics; add no manual trimming, delay correction, zero-padding, drift correction, gain/polarity fitting or time warping. Residual alignment is diagnostic only.
alignment_policy.support: Preserve every per-channel reason, nullable invalid diagnostic and unsupported case. Short, silent, highly impaired or ambiguous cases are not replaced. Alignment failure is not a severity label, and unsupported coverage may be outcome-dependent.
alignment_policy.omissions: This is not a complete full-reference perceptual oracle report: integrated loudness, true peak, metric-specific views, perceptual outcomes and their uncertainty are not supplied.
alignment_policy.geometry_boundary: A partial activity block may be rounded upward by the old diagnostic. Never permit that estimate to exceed observed aligned geometry for eligibility. One frame below four/eight seconds fails the corresponding study duration gate; numeric limits and legacy raw records are unchanged.

storage_and_stop.processing: One source/condition at a time. Fresh private temporary case directory, 32 MiB per subprocess output file, bounded metadata, one codec process at a time. Require 15 GiB plus 384 MiB scratch allowance before each case.
storage_and_stop.timing: Stop starting new cases after one hour per replay; an already started case has a 180-second deadline. Codec/probe commands each have at most 60 seconds, capped by the case deadline. Runtime overhead and inventory/binding preflight are additional. Report every remaining case as not_run; no automatic resume or replacement.
storage_and_stop.retention: Keep two private JSON replay reports, exact execution binding, out-of-band attribution and the sanitized projection in a new unique private directory. Do not retain encoded conditions, input adapters or decoded PCM. Only newly created case scratch is automatically removed.
storage_and_stop.failures: A preflight mismatch prevents execution. Within-case codec, geometry, deadline or support failures stay in the denominator. Resource stops preserve unattempted cases. Byte mismatch yields a technical negative, not an automatic repair.
storage_and_stop.publication: Public projection is aggregate only, built from an allowlist. No private path, case/source identity, waveform, per-member hash, packet record, score or listener data is copied into Git.

software_boundary.binding: Exact executable and recursive non-system shared-library hashes; Python executable, all runtime .py/.so bytes excluding tests/site-packages/caches; package formula and present licence-notice hashes.
software_boundary.system_binding: macOS 26.6.2 build 25G83 arm64 binds dyld shared-cache libraries. These system libraries are not individually file-hashed and are not claimed independently reproducible on another OS.
software_boundary.use_scope: Existing installed software, local subprocess research only. No installation, patching, distribution of tools/libraries, application linking, metric licence selection or public product change. Package declarations are inventory metadata, not a new redistribution clearance.
software_boundary.runtime: Real execution requires Python isolated mode (-I), exact binding equality, controlled subprocess environment and no external media protocols or dynamic plugins.

execution_gate.authorization_policy: Create the exact successor only after explicit user approval of this proposal. It must bind the unchanged proposal and runner, open only the two retained-reference technical replays, and keep metric/playback/listener/training permission false.
execution_gate.commit_and_ci: Commit and push the approved successor; require a clean checkout and a successful push CI run at the exact execution HEAD. The runner checks that live before inspecting private paths.
execution_gate.preparation_access: Public repository records, tool binaries/dependencies/installed help and small constructed numerical/WAV test fixtures only. Real waveform and private-manifest access stays closed in this checkpoint.

validation_requirements: Exact public bindings, recipes and 320-case accounting
Fail closed before private access when approval, clean commit, exact-head CI or native tool binding differs
Constructed 24/32-bit PCM and binary32 conversion controls, finite-value and channel geometry checks
Mocked encoder/probe/decoder boundary with no actual codec conditions generated
Timeout/resource stops, corrupted inventory, symlinks, duplicate identities, extra files and no-clobber behavior
Two complete mocked replays, deliberate non-determinism and every failed/unsupported case retained
Path-free aggregate projection; no perceptual value coercion
Full local Rust/Python checks, deterministic repository SBOM, full staged audit and successful exact-head CI
next_action: After tested publication, ask the user to approve exactly the two private 160-case technical replays. Do not ask for a microphone, listening participation, recruitment, spending or a broader research waiver.
